prior_block:
PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds t revealed
in earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- The amounts are final thresholds as they were revealed: they already contain whatever
  deductible, VAT and customary-price judgement applied in those cases, and they were computed
  from the full invoiced quantity (the whole quantity was indemnified there). For an
  indemnified line of this type take the stated amount for the line as t as it stands and give
  a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. Do not deduct a deductible from it and do not
  cut the invoiced quantity.
- Deviate only for something this case has and those cases did not: an aggregate cap or
  sub-limit that the lines of this invoice must share, a percentage reduction for a breached
  duty, or a purchase price or sum insured stated in the claim that limits the line.
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only says how often this line type was paid at all. A line type
  that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies do not carry;
  treat it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 5 "Vehicle costs": indemnified in 3 of 9 earlier cases, t = 0 in 6; when indemnified t per pc about 71 (80% range 54 to 95); revealed per pc: 12.9-16.1 (case 14*), >=60 (case 16*), >=68 (case 18) (* = other policy wording)

items.rationale: The attendance and survey qualify under §7.1.7(e), and this is the first call-out under §7.1.7(f). Estimated at €150 gross for attendance and the initial survey, excluding separately billed pinpointing and measurements.
Pinpointing the source beneath the sink is necessary investigation under §7.1.7(e). Allow €245 gross for the specialist service, not a separate charge for the contractor’s own device under §7.1.8(b).

items.description: Kitchen floor and wall moisture measurement
items.rationale: Measuring the extent of moisture in the affected floor and wall base is covered under §7.1.7(e). Allow €125 gross for the survey of both surfaces.

Sections 7.1.7(g) and 7.1.8(c) allow necessary, nonduplicated labour, not an automatic allowance for all 14 hours on top of the itemised surveys. The conditional estimate is €360 gross for four additional hours at €90, if substantiated.

The call-out at position 1 is the first attendance charge, so §7.1.7(f) excludes the separately billed van charge. The €71 estimate is conditional on the charge being accepted as the sole eligible travel charge.
Opening up the affected under-sink pipe run is necessary access work under §§7.1.1(b) and 7.1.7(a). Allow €175 gross for localised access, without wider dismantling.

items.description: Remove and dispose of damaged insulation
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(a) covers stripping and disposing of the affected insulation. Allow €56 gross for both pieces at €28 each.

items.description: Repair copper pipe and reinstate insulation
items.rationale: The local supply-pipe failure is consistent with covered internal pipe damage under §2.4.3(a); §§7.1.1(b) and 7.1.7(c) and (g) allow the necessary like-for-like work. Allow €440 gross for the short section, fittings, standard insulation and repair labour, excluding separately billed access and removal.

Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(b) require evidence of event-related moisture in the area dried; only the kitchen is documented. The €300 estimate is conditional on proof that separate roof-space drying was needed.
Necessary equipment hire for the documented kitchen moisture is covered under §7.1.7(b) and (e). Allow €245 gross for one dryer rental, without separately billed power under §7.1.8(d).

items.description: Dry kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(b) covers drying the documented wet floor and wall base, and §7.1.8(c) bars charging for the dryer twice. Allow €360 gross for distinct setup, drying labour and monitoring, excluding the hire at position 10.

items.description: Additional transition pieces and pipe insulation
items.rationale: The repaired section’s fittings and standard insulation are already provided for at position 8; no distinct installation is documented under §7.1.8(c) and (e). The €75 estimate is conditional on proof of separate necessary materials.

General final cleaning is excluded by §7.1.8(a), even within the covered work area; removal of specific repair debris is not described. The €55 estimate is conditional on proof of distinct covered debris removal under §5.2.1.
This is the first and only vehicle charge on the drying contractor’s invoice under §7.1.7(f). Allow the €71 gross standard charge.
Section 7.1.7(h) expressly covers removing the damaged furnishing from the dwelling. Allow €40 gross for carrying out one plain pine table, separate from haulage.

items.description: Transport and dispose of damaged table
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(h) covers transport away, and §5.2.1 covers necessary disposal of the damaged insured item. Allow €75 gross for the two billed tasks on one table: €50 haulage and €25 disposal.
The scheduled new-for-old option under §§4.4 and 7.1.1(d) removes the age deduction, and the same model meets §7.1.9. At 19% VAT under §7.7, €440 × 1.19 = €523.60 gross.
Section 7.1.7(h) expressly covers delivery of the replacement furnishing. Allow €55 gross for ordinary local delivery, distinct from contractor attendance.

items.description: Assemble table and clean its installation area
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(h) covers assembly and cleaning limited to the position where the damaged table stood. Allow €65 gross for both tasks, not general room cleaning.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first vehicle charge on this invoice, provided it is distinct from the table transport and delivery services. Allow €71 gross.
Section 7.1.7(f) excludes a second travel charge on the same invoice regardless of the number of visits. The €71 conditional estimate reflects one ordinary trip, not an additional payable allowance.

Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(f) exclude testing furniture not shown to be affected by the kitchen leak; §4.2.6 also defines insured furnishings as items kept inside the dwelling. The €65 estimate is conditional on evidence bringing the inspection within cover.
